narrativeProgression.description: Joe Lieberman discusses a recent poll showing support for a third-party ticket in the next election.
Joe Lieberman states they finished a poll of 35,000 voters across the country.
The poll reveals strong support for a third-party, bipartisan unity ticket.
Lieberman suggests people are fed up with the two major parties and want an alternative to Trump and Biden.

scenes.thematicElements: Public dissatisfaction with current political options, potential for a viable third-party candidate, desire for unity and bipartisanship.
